Rated as a major advance within a field: Low solar-neutrino counts initiated tests of solar models and neutrino properties.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Transferable charge arrays enabled sensitive digital imaging.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Vortex binding and unbinding established a transition beyond conventional symmetry breaking.

dateNote.en: Berezinskii’s Russian paper appeared in 1970 and its English translation in 1971; Kosterlitz and Thouless published their related work in 1973.

rationale.en: Rated as a major advance within a field: A charm quark explained the suppression of flavour-changing neutral currents.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Massive gauge theories became systematically calculable beyond classical order.
Rated as a key law, decisive evidence or the opening of a direction: Scale-dependent effective theories explained critical exponents and universality.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Controlled entanglement tests ruled out broad classes of local hidden-variable accounts.

dateNote.en: Major stages include the Freedman–Clauser experiment of 1972 and Aspect’s series of experiments in 1982; later loophole-free tests were performed in 2015.

rationale.en: Rated as a major advance within a field: Pairing of fermionic atoms produced multiple quantum-fluid phases.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Horizon area was linked to entropy, motivating the generalized second law.
Rated as a major advance within a field: A complex phase in three-generation quark mixing supplied a CP-violation mechanism.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Magnetic gradients encoded spatial position and turned NMR into imaging.
Rated as a key law, decisive evidence or the opening of a direction: Colour gauge theory and weakening high-energy coupling established the modern strong-interaction framework.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Neutrino scattering without charged leptons supported electroweak theory.
Rated as a major advance within a field: A neutron-star binary enabled precision indirect tests of gravitational radiation.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Quantum fields in curved spacetime predicted thermal black-hole radiation.
Rated as a key law, decisive evidence or the opening of a direction: Independent resonance discoveries established charm and strengthened the Standard Model.
Rated as a major advance within a field: A new heavy lepton revealed a third lepton generation.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Upsilon resonances established the bottom member of a third quark generation.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Radiation-pressure cooling of trapped particles enabled precision standards and quantum control.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Three-jet electron–positron events established the strong-force gauge boson.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Hierarchical order parameters described complex equilibrium structures in disordered, frustrated systems.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Inflation supplies an important new mechanism for the early Universe, while its specific realization remains unconfirmed and its assessment provisional.

dateNote.en: The development includes Starobinsky’s 1980 model, Guth’s 1981 model and new inflation in 1982; the specific mechanism remains unconfirmed.

rationale.en: Rated as a key law, decisive evidence or the opening of a direction: Precisely quantized Hall resistance linked quantum matter with electrical metrology.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Tunnelling currents enabled atomic-scale imaging of conducting surfaces.
Rated as a key law, decisive evidence or the opening of a direction: Fractional quantum Hall plateaux in a two-dimensional electron system established a new strongly correlated electronic phenomenon.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Direct production tested a central prediction of electroweak unification.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Nonorthogonal states made eavesdropping disturbance detectable and founded a quantum-cryptography route.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Adiabatic cycles can acquire a phase determined by parameter-space geometry.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Stretching, amplifying, and recompressing pulses overcame damage limits for intense ultrashort lasers.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Superconducting circuits displayed tunnelling and discrete levels, enabling circuit quantum technologies.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Multiple laser beams damped atomic motion and enabled controlled ultracold-atom experiments.
Rated as a major advance within a field: A formal model established universal quantum computation.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Force-based probes extended nanoscale imaging to insulating surfaces.
Rated as a key law, decisive evidence or the opening of a direction: Cuprates exceeded conventional temperature expectations and opened correlated-superconductor research.
Rated as a major advance within a field: A stellar-collapse neutrino burst directly tested supernova-core physics.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Spin-dependent transport in magnetic multilayers drove spintronics.
Rated as a major advance within a field: P-type GaN and heterostructures solved key barriers to efficient blue emission.

dateNote.en: Key stages include p-type GaN in 1989 and high-brightness heterostructure devices in 1993.

rationale.en: Rated as a major advance within a field: A precise blackbody spectrum tested the thermal early-universe picture.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Large-scale temperature fluctuations connected structure formation with the early universe.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Entanglement and classical communication enabled transfer of an unknown quantum state.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Efficient factoring and discrete logarithms demonstrated a quantum computational advantage in principle.
Rated as a key law, decisive evidence or the opening of a direction: Controllable macroscopic coherent atomic matter waves became experimentally accessible.
Rated as a major advance within a field: 51 Pegasi b opened exoplanet studies around Sun-like main-sequence stars.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Encoding logical states showed that unknown quantum information could resist local errors.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Two Tevatron experiments completed the three-generation quark spectrum.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Coupling internal and motional states enabled controlled quantum logic.
Rated as a major advance within a field: A gravity–field-theory duality supplied tools for strong coupling and quantum gravity.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Entangled photons experimentally demonstrated quantum-state transfer.
Rated as a key law, decisive evidence or the opening of a direction: Type-Ia supernova distances revealed accelerated late-time cosmic expansion.
Rated as a key law, decisive evidence or the opening of a direction: Atmospheric and solar flavour changes established nonzero neutrino mass differences.

dateNote.en: Major evidence includes atmospheric-neutrino oscillations in 1998 and solar-neutrino flavour conversion in 2001–2002.

rationale.en: Rated as a focused advance: Coherent transparency slowed optical group velocity and advanced light–matter control.
Rated as a focused advance: DONUT directly identified tau-neutrino interactions, completing the three-flavour set.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Pulse trains and isolated pulses enabled time-resolved studies of electronic motion.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Tunable atoms realized a superfluid–Mott transition and advanced quantum simulation.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Tunable Fermi gases connected molecular condensation with paired superfluidity.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Stable atomically thin carbon and its field effect opened two-dimensional electronic-material research.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Stable merger and ringdown evolution opened reliable gravitational-wave waveform calculations.
Rated as a major advance within a field: RHIC results showed hot QCD matter behaving as a nearly ideal liquid.
Rated as a major advance within a field: HgTe quantum wells realized a topological phase with conducting edges at zero magnetic field.

Rated as a key law, decisive evidence or the opening of a direction: ATLAS and CMS discovered the corresponding new boson, completing a decisive Standard Model test; their joint discovery is counted once, separately from 1964 theory and the 2013 award.
Rated as a major advance within a field: IceCube established an extraterrestrial high-energy flux, opening high-energy neutrino astronomy.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Tests addressed locality and detection loopholes together, strengthening quantum-correlation evidence.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Weyl quasiparticles and Fermi arcs connected topological bands with transport.

Rated as a key law, decisive evidence or the opening of a direction: Directly detected gravitational waves and a binary-black-hole merger, opening a new observational window; credit follows the 2015 detection.

dateNote.en: GW150914 was directly detected on 14 September 2015; the result was announced on 11 February 2016 and published that year.

LIGO original release, 11 February 2016: detected 14 September 2015

rationale.en: Rated as a major advance within a field: Gravitational waves, gamma rays, and a kilonova tested merger physics and heavy-element origins.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Tunable moiré bands produced correlated insulation and superconductivity, opening twistronics.

Rated as a major advance within a field: Reconstructed the first black-hole-scale shadow image, a major strong-gravity imaging result; dated to the 2019 image result rather than the 2017 raw-data campaign.
Rated as a focused advance: Neutrino evidence for CNO burning directly tested stellar nuclear reactions.
Rated as a major advance within a field: NIF fusion output first exceeded incident laser energy, advancing burning-plasma experiments.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Correlated pulsar timing opened the nanohertz gravitational-wave observational window.
Rated as a focused advance: Below-threshold error correction is an important scalability test for quantum computing, with impact still too recent for a mature framework-level rating.
Rated as a focused advance: Extending observed CP asymmetry to baryon decays is a valuable new test, distinct from the first discovery of CP violation.
Rated as a key law, decisive evidence or the opening of a direction: Introduced intrinsic electron angular momentum as a key ingredient of atomic spectra.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Established an exchange-based description of magnetic ordering.
Rated as an important improvement: Established a mass-two hydrogen isotope through spectroscopy.
Rated as an important improvement: Quantified fission barriers and conditions in the liquid-drop model; credit is limited to calculation beyond the original discovery and basic interpretation.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Determined neutrino helicity using a nuclear reaction and photon polarization.
Rated as an important improvement: Recast interactions using auxiliary fields for quantum statistical calculations.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Established inelastic-neutron measurements of lattice excitations.
Rated as a key law, decisive evidence or the opening of a direction: Connected superconducting ideas to dynamical symmetry breaking in particle theory.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Tested gravitational frequency shifts with resonant gamma rays.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Organized hadron multiplets with SU(3), preceding the quark model.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Demonstrated frequency doubling of laser light in quartz.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Rocket observations opened the field of extrasolar X-ray astronomy.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Introduced a mixing angle into hadronic weak decays.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Exchange-scattering corrections explained an anomalous low-temperature resistance trend.
Rated as an important improvement: Numerical wave studies identified stable localized excitations after collisions.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Established a finite-temperature restriction on ordering in low-dimensional isotropic models.
Rated as an important improvement: Constructed a dual amplitude with Regge behavior, an important antecedent of string theory.
Rated as an important improvement: Examined correlations with the environment in quantum measurement.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Provided theoretical foundations for multiple superfluid phases of helium-3.
Rated as an important improvement: Constructed interacting four-dimensional supersymmetric field theory, advancing theoretical tools without treating superpartner particles as observed.
Rated as an important improvement: Linked local supersymmetry with gravitation, extending theory construction without claiming experimental confirmation.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Formulated scale evolution through parton splitting probabilities for QCD phenomenology.
Rated as an important improvement: Proposed an intermediate hexatic phase in two-dimensional melting.
Rated as an important improvement: Characterized environmentally selected stable measurement states.
Rated as a key law, decisive evidence or the opening of a direction: Related quantized Hall conductance to integer band topology.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Distinguished low-energy behavior of integer and half-integer antiferromagnetic chains.
Rated as a key law, decisive evidence or the opening of a direction: Explained fractional Hall states through correlated many-body wavefunctions and fractional excitations.
Rated as an important improvement: Recovered fluid equations from discrete lattice-gas rules.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Trapped dielectric particles with a focused beam for precise optical manipulation.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Resolved individual quantum jumps through electron shelving and intermittent fluorescence.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Demonstrated a lattice route to quantized Hall topology without net magnetic flux.
Rated as an important improvement: Used small feedback perturbations to stabilize unstable periodic orbits.
Rated as an important improvement: Showed synchronization of appropriately coupled chaotic subsystems.
Rated as an important improvement: Applied entanglement and Bell tests to quantum key distribution.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Used reduced density matrices to choose effective states for strongly correlated calculations.
Rated as an important improvement: Identified orbital angular momentum in structured laser modes.
Rated as an important improvement: Developed strong-field quantum calculations of harmonic spectra.
Rated as an important improvement: Used atomic probes to track the loss of cavity-field coherence.
Rated as an important improvement: Identified quantum tunnelling between collective spin states in molecular magnets.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Connected nonequilibrium work statistics with equilibrium free-energy differences.
Rated as an important improvement: Introduced an influential geometrical hierarchy model; extra dimensions lack direct evidence, so it is not rated as an experimentally established law.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Demonstrated a composite electromagnetic medium with simultaneous negative responses.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Linked optical and microwave frequencies coherently for precision metrology.

Rated as an important improvement: Proposed recovering near-field information with negative refraction; rated as an important theoretical proposal rather than unconditional realization of a perfect lens.
Rated as an important improvement: Extended generating-function methods to networks with general degree distributions.
Rated as a focused advance: Provided a computable entanglement measure for mixed states.
Rated as a focused advance: Confirmation of a new superheavy element advances nuclear synthesis without equating one additional element with a new physical framework.
Rated as a major advance within a field: Extended topological insulating phases to three dimensions.
